Dual Contouring API function: algo.dualContouring The Dual Contouring algorithm creates a new mesh representing the selected occurrences. This is built using an improved version of the Dual Contouring algorithm, built on an octree. The algorithm The dual contouring is in essence quite similar to the marching cubes.
